Before connecting an account or trial, Levik VPN sends your device label, model, OS and app versions, plus an identifier derived from a non-exportable Android Keystore key. This binds the VPN profile to the device and prevents repeated trial claims. The official Play build also asks Google Play Integrity to verify the app, license, and device integrity; Levik VPN receives those technical verdicts. This does not include your files, messages, or browsing content.

Levik VPN will create an encrypted, device-wide VPN tunnel and route non-local network traffic through the selected Levik VPN server while connected. Local, link-local and multicast networks always bypass the tunnel. If direct access to Russian sites is enabled in Settings, matching domains and IP addresses also bypass the VPN. Android will show a persistent VPN notification. The app calculates connection duration and traffic counters locally for status and does not inspect or collect your browsing content.

Fragment packets to bypass DPI censorship firewalls
Splitting packets into chunks with slight delays prevents Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) systems from identifying and blocking encrypted tunnel handshakes.

Levik VPN can anonymously report when a connection fails or drops: the server, protocol, error code, network type and network operator. The server derives the operator from the request address and does not store the address. Websites you visit, traffic and account or device identifiers are never sent. You can change this at any time in Settings.
